<tbody><tr><td>

[close()](./api.asrsession.close.md)


</td><td>

Close the session. Commits any pending audio and delivers the resulting finals to onFinal subscribers before resolving, then releases the broker reference (which may then idle-unload the model). Keep onFinal subscribed until close() resolves if the last utterance matters. Idempotent.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[onError(callback)](./api.asrsession.onerror.md)


</td><td>

Subscribe to session-level errors (model load failure, sidecar crash, malformed audio, etc). The session is closed by Moss after an error fires; callers should treat the error as terminal.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[onFinal(callback)](./api.asrsession.onfinal.md)


</td><td>

Subscribe to committed transcripts. Returns an unsubscribe function. Multiple subscribers are fine; each gets every event.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[onPartial(callback)](./api.asrsession.onpartial.md)


</td><td>

Subscribe to in-progress transcripts. \*\*Not emitted in v1\*\* — whisper.cpp's batch shape and the cost of per-window encoder passes mean Moss currently only emits finals. Returning a no-op unsubscribe lets caller code be written for the future without breaking when partials are eventually wired.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[pushAudio(pcm16, endOfUtterance)](./api.asrsession.pushaudio.md)


</td><td>

Push a PCM16 chunk. Pass `endOfUtterance: true` if you have your own VAD and know an utterance just ended; otherwise let Moss decide when to commit (it force-flushes after a buffered window). Resolves once the host has accepted the audio; the final for a commit arrives later on onFinal, never before this resolves.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>
